importPage.title: Bring your data across
importPage.subtitle: Import from another browser so you start where you left off.
importPage.description: Bork can copy your saved passwords, bookmarks, history and cookies from Vivaldi, Chrome, Edge, Safari and other browsers you have installed.

bookmarks.label: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: The whole tree, folders and all

history.label: History
history.description: So the address bar knows your habits

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.description: Stay signed in where you already were

importPage.opened: The import window is open — finish there, then come back.
importPage.passwordNote: Importing passwords asks your operating system for permission to unlock the other browser’s password store. That prompt comes from macOS or Windows, not from Bork.
importPage.skipNote: You can skip this and import later from the menu at any time.
importPage.looking: Looking for browsers you already use…
importPage.noneFound: No other browsers with data to import were found on this computer.
importPage.failed: That import did not finish. Nothing was changed.
importPage.passwordNoteAll: With every browser selected you will get one of those prompts per browser.

hubPage.title: About Bork Hub
hubPage.subtitle: A central place for Bork specific settings.
hubPage.description: Bork Hub is a dedicated settings center for Bork specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:preferences'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.
hubPage.tip: Tip: You can also access Bork Hub from the Firefox setting's sidebar.

features.accessible: All in one place at about:preferences
features.centralized: All Bork specific options in one place

customize.title: Customise Bork
customize.description: Customise to your preferred settings. You can always change them later from the Bork Hub or settings page.

appearance.title: Appearance Settings
appearance.description: You can customise Bork's appearance to your preference. Choose a light or dark theme, or have it automatically switch based on your system settings.

floorpHub.title: Bork Hub
floorpHub.description: Bork's settings live inside Firefox's Settings page: Tab & Appearance, Workspaces, the panel sidebar, gestures and shortcuts all have their own panes at 'about:preferences'.

finish.title: Setup Complete!
finish.subtitle: Congratulations! You've completed the Bork setup. Enjoy a comfortable and secure internet browsing experience.
finish.hint: For more detailed settings, you can customize via the Settings option in the menu button at the top right.

welcomePage.description: Bork is a fast and user-friendly web browser that emphasises privacy and security. This guide will introduce you to the main features and settings of Bork.
welcomePage.readyToStart: When you're ready, click the below button to proceed.

localizationPage.title: Bork speaks your language
localizationPage.subtitle: Check language settings and change if needed
localizationPage.chooseLanguage: Choose from a wide range of languages
localizationPage.languageChangeNotice: Changing language will apply the new language without restarting Bork. Some add-ons may not support language changes.

featuresPage.title: Main Bork Features
featuresPage.subtitle: Bork comes with many useful features. Check out the feature overview!

panelSidebar.title: Panel Sidebar
panelSidebar.description: Access convenient features from the sidebar on the right while browsing. You can place web panels, note-taking functions, add-ons, bookmarks, etc. in the sidebar.
features: Quickly take notes with Bork Notes while browsing

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Organize multiple tab sets to streamline your work. Quickly switch between workspaces with distinctive icons and names. Access via the workspace button in the top left.
features: Categorize by purpose: work, personal, etc.

pwa.title: Progressive Web Applications Support
pwa.description: On Windows, you can add PWA-compatible sites as desktop applications when you visit them. Regular websites can also be installed.
features: Can be pinned to the taskbar

mouseGesture.title: Mouse Gestures
mouseGesture.description: Control your browser more intuitively with natively implemented mouse gesture functionality. Execute gestures by holding the right-click button and moving your mouse.

finishPage.title: Setup Complete!
finishPage.subtitle: Congratulations! You've completed the Bork setup. You can now enjoy comfortable and secure internet browsing.
finishPage.hint: For more detailed settings, you can customise via the Settings option in the menu button at the top right.
finishPage.defaultBrowserSuccess: Bork has been set as your default browser!

whatsNew.title: Welcome to Bork {{version}}!
whatsNew.subtitle: Check out what's new in Bork!
